```{r doc-code, include=FALSE}
source("../code/R/doc_code.R")
```

All panels are produced by
[`script/FigureS11.R`](https://github.com/dzemmour/immgenT-cosmo-paper/blob/main/script/FigureS11.R).
The code below is shown for reference (not re-executed on this page); the
images are its pre-rendered output.

The script draws panel (C) first and releases its object before loading the
complete atlas for (A) and (B), so that only one large object is in memory at a
time. Panels (A) and (B) are the one place in this repository that needs the
complete atlas rather than the gene-subsetted one: three of the six transcripts
in (B) were dropped when the subsetted object was built.

## (A) Th tip clusters on the CD4 MDE {#figs11a}

```{r figs11a-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS11.R", "S11a"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs11a-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="50%"}
knitr::include_graphics("assets/ExtendedDataFigure11/S11a_CD4MDE_Th_tips.png")
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 11A.** CD4-specific MDE highlighting the Th1 (CD4.R/S),
Th2 (CD4.T/U) and Th17 (CD4.X/Y) "tip" clusters, so named because each sits at
the end of a projection from the main CD4 body.
:::

## (B) Th-defining receptor transcripts {#figs11b}

```{r figs11b-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS11.R", "S11b"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs11b-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="32%"}
knitr::include_graphics(c(
  "assets/ExtendedDataFigure11/S11b_CD4MDE_Cxcr3.png",
  "assets/ExtendedDataFigure11/S11b_CD4MDE_Il12rb2.png",
  "assets/ExtendedDataFigure11/S11b_CD4MDE_Ccr4.png",
  "assets/ExtendedDataFigure11/S11b_CD4MDE_Il4ra.png",
  "assets/ExtendedDataFigure11/S11b_CD4MDE_Ccr6.png",
  "assets/ExtendedDataFigure11/S11b_CD4MDE_Il23r.png"))
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 11B.** CD4-specific MDE showing expression of Cxcr3,
Il12rb2, Ccr4, Il4ra, Ccr6 and Il23r. None of these commonly used identifiers
of Th differentiation is specific for the polarised tip cluster it is used to
define — Cxcr3 and Il12rb2 for Th1, Ccr4 and Il4ra for Th2, Ccr6 for Th17 —
with Il23r in the Th17 tip the sole exception.
:::

## (C) Core Treg signature across the atlas {#figs11c}

```{r figs11c-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS11.R", "S11c"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs11c-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="50%"}
knitr::include_graphics("assets/ExtendedDataFigure11/S11c_MDE_treg_core_signature.png")
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 11C.** All-T MDE showing expression of the core Treg gene
signature (Zemmour et al.) across all immgenT T cells. A signature derived from
one state is not confined to it.
:::
